name: io.github.ChristophEnglisch/keycloak-model-context-protocol
description: Manage Keycloak users, groups, roles and realms through the Keycloak Admin REST API.

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Keycloak server, e.g. https://keycloak.example.com

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_AUTH_REALM
environmentVariables.description: Realm used to obtain the admin token

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID used for login (default admin-cli for the password grant, required for client_credentials)

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret for the client_credentials grant (recommended: a dedicated service account)

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Username for the password grant (alternative to client credentials)

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_GRANT_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Grant type; auto-detected if unset (client_credentials when a secret is set, else password)

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: If true, only read-only tools are registered

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_MCP_REALMS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of target realms; empty means all realms

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_MCP_ALLOW_MASTER_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: If true, write tools may modify the master realm

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated enabled toolsets (core, groups, roles, clients, sessions, events, security) or all

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_MCP_REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION
environmentVariables.description: If true, destructive tools require confirm=true

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout for Keycloak requests in milliseconds
